prompt: 我改了 build.sh，想只重跑 build 和 test 這兩個 stage，不要執行 deploy。我的 pipeline stages 是 build, test, deploy。當前 project 是 backend，環境是 dev-env。指令怎麼下？

assertions.text: Uses `--to test` flag to stop before deploy (e.g. `kde proj pipeline backend --to test`)
Correctly names the project (`backend`) in the command
Does NOT suggest running deploy stage when user explicitly wants to skip it
Explains what the flag does (stopping at test stage)
